name: blueprint/deploy-journal
description: Deploys with a paper trail: before-receipt, the deploy command, smoke checks, after-receipt, and a revert path from the undo trail
recipe: write the before-receipt (what will change) -> deploy via rh_run -> smoke-check with the same command -> after-receipt; red smokes revert from the undo trail
pitfalls: a red smoke is a deploy to revert, not a warning to ignore
